fields.description: BRD C.4.1 -- "targets a configurable stock level (≈ three months mandatory)". The reorder engine's target stock = average monthly retail sales × this many months.
fields.label: Target Stock (Months of Avg Sales)

fields.description: BRD C.4.2 -- company-level stock MOQ floor: applied to a reorder suggestion when neither the Item nor its default Supplier has one set. 0 means no site-wide floor.
fields.label: Default MOQ (Boxes)

fields.description: BRD C.4.2 -- "production MOQ may differ from stock MOQ" -- company-level floor for a quantity confirmed must-produce (not available from ready stock), same Item -> Supplier -> Company fallback as the stock MOQ. 0 means no site-wide floor.
fields.label: Default Production MOQ (Boxes)
